key: You see all these bars throughout the tent?
en: You see all these bars throughout the tent?
ja: テントのあちこちにバーがあるだろ?

key: When Ciel dances, she hangs and moves between them using ribbons. It's fantastic!
en: When Ciel dances, she hangs and moves between them using ribbons. It's fantastic!
ja: シエルが踊るときは、リボンを使ってバーの間を移動するんだ。すごいんだぜ!

key: This is just an intermission, right?
en: This is just an intermission, right?
ja: 今はただの休憩時間だよね?

key: Awh man, I don't even wanna get up.
en: Awh man, I don't even wanna get up.
ja: あーあ、立ち上がるのもめんどくさいな。

key: Can't I just sit here until the next show?
en: Can't I just sit here until the next show?
ja: 次のショーまでここに座ってちゃダメかな?

key: This stupid thing keeps breathing down my neck!
en: This stupid thing keeps breathing down my neck!
ja: こいつ、ずっと首元で息してくるんだけど!

key: Do you think Ciel would give me her autograph?
en: Do you think Ciel would give me her autograph?
ja: シエルってサインしてくれるかな?

key: How about a kiss?
en: How about a kiss?
ja: キスは無理かな?

key: The strongman portion of the show was intense!
en: The strongman portion of the show was intense!
ja: 怪力男のコーナーはすごい迫力だった!

key: The whole floor is a panel system for the big High Striker, and even just the smallest things Samson did would trigger the bell!
en: The whole floor is a panel system for the big High Striker, and even just the smallest things Samson did would trigger the bell!
ja: 床全体が大きなハイストライカーのパネルになってて、サムソンがちょっと動くだけでベルが鳴るんだ!

key: I mean... it's cooler to see than to hear described.
en: I mean... it's cooler to see than to hear described.
ja: って言っても……話で聞くより、実際に見たほうが断然かっこいいけどね。

key: Some of the clowns are pretty lifeless around here, but there's one that really stands out.
en: Some of the clowns are pretty lifeless around here, but there's one that really stands out.
ja: この辺のピエロはけっこう地味なのが多いけど、ひとりだけ目立つ子がいるんだ。

key: She's got rainbow hair, and the whole tent practically shakes when she's around!
en: She's got rainbow hair, and the whole tent practically shakes when she's around!
ja: 虹色の髪をしてて、その子が来るとテント中が揺れるくらい盛り上がるんだよ!

key: I snuck in here for the show. Don't tell!
en: I snuck in here for the show. Don't tell!
ja: こっそり忍びこんでショーを見てるんだ。内緒だぞ!

key: Secretly, I am the show! You may hold your applause!
en: Secretly, I am the show! You may hold your applause!
ja: ダルコ: 実を言うと、ショーの主役はこの俺だ! 拍手はまだ早いぜ!

key: Someday I'll get up to Ciel's level.
en: Someday I'll get up to Ciel's level.
ja: いつか自分もシエルみたいになりたいな。

key: ???: Ah, more latecomers still?
en: ???: Ah, more latecomers still?
ja: ???: おや、また遅れてきたお客さんかい?

key: So sorry everyone, but I'm afraid that's all she wrote!
en: So sorry everyone, but I'm afraid that's all she wrote!
ja: 申し訳ないけど、今日のショーはこれでおしまいなんだ!

key: Do come back for our next show!
en: Do come back for our next show!
ja: また次のショーにも来てくれよな!

key: ???: Oh, Samson.
en: ???: Oh, Samson.
ja: ???: あら、サムソン。

key: Is this the boy they were talking about?
en: Is this the boy they were talking about?
ja: みんなが話してた男の子って、この子のこと?

key: I'm surprised he's conscious.
en: I'm surprised he's conscious.
ja: 意識があるなんて意外だわ。

key: Who is this?
en: Who is this?
ja: この子は誰?

key: SAMSON: This is...
en: SAMSON: This is...
ja: サムソン: こいつは……

key: Actually, I forgot to ask their name.
en: Actually, I forgot to ask their name.
ja: って、名前を聞くの忘れてたな。

key: ???: Unctuous as always, hm, Samson?
en: ???: Unctuous as always, hm, Samson?
ja: ???: 相変わらず抜けてるのね、サムソン?

key: My name is Ciel.
en: My name is Ciel.
ja: わたしの名前はシエルよ。

key: I'm the spotlit starlet of the Agate Circus specialty show.
en: I'm the spotlit starlet of the Agate Circus specialty show.
ja: アゲートサーカス特別公演の花形スターですの。

key: Aerial ballet is my forte.
en: Aerial ballet is my forte.
ja: 空中バレエが得意ですわ。

key: A pleasure to meet you, darling.
en: A pleasure to meet you, darling.
ja: はじめまして、ダーリン。

key: SAMSON: Anyway, \PN is here for the girl.
en: SAMSON: Anyway, \PN is here for the girl.
ja: サムソン: とにかく、\PNはあの子を迎えに来たんだ。

key: CIEL: Oh! Superb, I was worried no one would claim her.
en: CIEL: Oh! Superb, I was worried no one would claim her.
ja: シエル: あら! よかった、誰も迎えに来ないんじゃないかと心配してましたの。

key: Follow me-- She's just back this way.
en: Follow me-- She's just back this way.
ja: こちらへどうぞ――すぐそこにいますわ。

key: RINGMASTER: Ladies aaaaand gentlemen!
en: RINGMASTER: Ladies aaaaand gentlemen!
ja: 団長: 紳士淑女のみなさああん!

key: Your attention please to another exciting exclusive challenge to the esteemed Agate Ace Triumvirate of Leaders!
en: Your attention please to another exciting exclusive challenge to the esteemed Agate Ace Triumvirate of Leaders!
ja: アゲート三強ジムリーダーへの、またとない挑戦の一戦にご注目を!

key: Today we have the rematch of challenger \PN versus Agate Circus Strongman SAMSON!!!
en: Today we have the rematch of challenger \PN versus Agate Circus Strongman SAMSON!!!
ja: 本日は、挑戦者\PNとアゲートサーカスの怪力男サムソンの再戦です!!!

key: As before, this will be a six-on-six Single Battle!
en: As before, this will be a six-on-six Single Battle!
ja: 前回同様、6対6のシングルバトルでお届けします!

key: SAMSON: This'll be over before you know it.
en: SAMSON: This'll be over before you know it.
ja: サムソン: あっという間に終わらせてやるぜ。

key: RINGMASTER: And begin!
en: RINGMASTER: And begin!
ja: 団長: それでは、開始!

key: Your attention please to an exciting exclusive challenge to the esteemed Agate Ace Triumvirate of Leaders!
en: Your attention please to an exciting exclusive challenge to the esteemed Agate Ace Triumvirate of Leaders!
ja: アゲート三強ジムリーダーへの、またとない挑戦の一戦にご注目を!

key: Today, in the left corner, we have a first-time challenger to Agate... \PN!!!
en: Today, in the left corner, we have a first-time challenger to Agate... \PN!!!
ja: 本日、左のコーナーには、アゲート初挑戦の若者……\PN!!!

key: And in the right corner--
en: And in the right corner--
ja: そして、右のコーナーには――

key: You've seen him at the Striker, busting bells into the sky...
en: You've seen him at the Striker, busting bells into the sky...
ja: ハイストライカーでベルを空高く打ち上げるその姿を、あなたも見たはず……

key: You've seen him in the Big Top, juggling people as if they could fly...
en: You've seen him in the Big Top, juggling people as if they could fly...
ja: ビッグトップでは、人を宙に舞わせるジャグリングを披露……

key: And now you're gonna see him on the center stage as he shows us what POWER really means!
en: And now you're gonna see him on the center stage as he shows us what POWER really means!
ja: そして今、センターステージで本物のパワーというものを見せつける!

key: He's the Agate Circus...
en: He's the Agate Circus...
ja: 彼こそはアゲートサーカスの……

key: Strongmaaaaaan...
en: Strongmaaaaaan...
ja: 怪力男うううう……

key: SAAAAAAMSOOOOON!!!
en: SAAAAAAMSOOOOON!!!
ja: サアアアムソオオオン!!!

key: SAMSON: How we all doin'?
en: SAMSON: How we all doin'?
ja: サムソン: みんな元気か?

key: RINGMASTER: This will be a six-on-six Single Battle!
en: RINGMASTER: This will be a six-on-six Single Battle!
ja: 団長: 6対6のシングルバトルです!

key: SAMSON: All right. Let's see an all-in and knock-out fight!
en: SAMSON: All right. Let's see an all-in and knock-out fight!
ja: サムソン: よし、全力でぶちのめし合おうぜ!

key: Go on and get wrecked!
en: Go on and get wrecked!
ja: さあ、ぶっ飛ばされてみろ!

key: Tch. This isn't the worst thing I've lost.
en: Tch. This isn't the worst thing I've lost.
ja: ちっ。もっとデカいもんを　失ったこともあるさ

key: RINGMASTER: And there you have it, folks! \PN is the victor!
en: RINGMASTER: And there you have it, folks! \PN is the victor!
ja: 団長: 決着です、みなさん! 勝者は\PN!

key: SAMSON: Chewed up and spit out.
en: SAMSON: Chewed up and spit out.
ja: サムソン: ぼろぼろにやられちまったな。

key: Good game, \PN.
en: Good game, \PN.
ja: いい勝負だったぜ、\PN。

key: RINGMASTER: For \PN, one braaand-new Strike Badge!
en: RINGMASTER: For \PN, one braaand-new Strike Badge!
ja: 団長: \PNに贈るは、ぴっかぴかのストライクバッジ!

key: \PN received the Strike Badge!
en: \PN received the Strike Badge!
ja: \PNはストライクバッジを手に入れた!

key: RINGMASTER: The Strike Badge grants its holder the much sought-after ability to use the Machine Surf!
en: RINGMASTER: The Strike Badge grants its holder the much sought-after ability to use the Machine Surf!
ja: 団長: ストライクバッジがあれば、みんな憧れの『なみのり』のマシンが使えるようになるぞ!

key: But that's not all!
en: But that's not all!
ja: だが、それだけじゃない!

key: \PN also wins the TM... Brick Break!
en: \PN also wins the TM... Brick Break!
ja: \PNはわざマシン……『かわらわり』もゲットだ!

key: RINGMASTER: And for those of you itching to challenge Samson or our other Leaders of the Agate Ace Triumvirate...
en: RINGMASTER: And for those of you itching to challenge Samson or our other Leaders of the Agate Ace Triumvirate...
ja: 団長: サムソンや、アゲート三強の他のリーダーに挑みたくてうずうずしてるそこのあなた……

key: Just find those Battle Passes!
en: Just find those Battle Passes!
ja: バトルパスを見つけるんだ!

key: Thanks for coming, everybody!
en: Thanks for coming, everybody!
ja: みんな、来てくれてありがとう!

key: Today we have the rematch of challenger \PN versus the Agate Circus' very own spotlit starlet, Ciel!
en: Today we have the rematch of challenger \PN versus the Agate Circus' very own spotlit starlet, Ciel!
ja: 本日は、挑戦者\PNとアゲートサーカス花形スター、シエルの再戦です!

key: CIEL: There is always an encore in my business, you know?
en: CIEL: There is always an encore in my business, you know?
ja: シエル: わたしの仕事にアンコールはつきものですのよ?

key: I will be glad to deliver!
en: I will be glad to deliver!
ja: 喜んでお応えしますわ!

key: Let's see you keep up, \PN!
en: Let's see you keep up, \PN!
ja: ついてこられるかしら、\PN!

key: Today, in the left corner, we have a returning challenger to Agate... \PN!!!
en: Today, in the left corner, we have a returning challenger to Agate... \PN!!!
ja: 本日、左のコーナーには、アゲート再挑戦の若者……\PN!!!

key: You've seen her prancing through the stage!
en: You've seen her prancing through the stage!
ja: 彼女がステージを軽やかに舞う姿を、あなたも見たはず!

key: And not just the stage-- the very air itself!
en: And not just the stage-- the very air itself!
ja: いや、ステージだけじゃない――空そのものを!

key: Dancing through the skies and hearts the same...
en: Dancing through the skies and hearts the same...
ja: 空を舞い、みんなの心も舞わせる……

key: She is Agate Circus' very own spotlit starlet...
en: She is Agate Circus' very own spotlit starlet...
ja: 彼女こそはアゲートサーカス花形スター……

key: Ciel!!!
en: Ciel!!!
ja: シエル!!!

key: CIEL: Thank you, thank you!
en: CIEL: Thank you, thank you!
ja: シエル: ありがとう、ありがとう!

key: You are too kind, my fans! And too generous!
en: You are too kind, my fans! And too generous!
ja: みなさん優しすぎますわ! それに気前がよすぎ!

key: Let us see how our performers dazzle us today!
en: Let us see how our performers dazzle us today!
ja: さあ、今日も演者たちが目を楽しませてくれますわよ!

key: CIEL: I don't intend to disappoint, and I expect the same of you, \PN!
en: CIEL: I don't intend to disappoint, and I expect the same of you, \PN!
ja: シエル: がっかりさせるつもりはありませんし、あなたにもそれを期待しますわ、\PN!

key: I want to see your very best!
en: I want to see your very best!
ja: あなたの全力を見せてくださいまし!

key: This is your moment, so show me what you can do!
en: This is your moment, so show me what you can do!
ja: 今がその時ですわ、その実力を見せてくださいまし!

key: Bravo, my dear! You've stuck the landing!
en: Bravo, my dear! You've stuck the landing!
ja: ブラボー! 見事に　着地を　決めましたわね!

key: RINGMASTER: There it is! \PN seizes victory this time!
en: RINGMASTER: There it is! \PN seizes victory this time!
ja: 団長: 決まった! 今回は\PNが勝利をつかんだ!

key: CIEL: And I don't regret it in the least.
en: CIEL: And I don't regret it in the least.
ja: シエル: これっぽっちも悔いはありませんわ。

key: Good show, \PN! Good show!
en: Good show, \PN! Good show!
ja: いいショーでしたわ、\PN! 見事!

key: RINGMASTER: And \PN's prize today is the Suspension Badge!
en: RINGMASTER: And \PN's prize today is the Suspension Badge!
ja: 団長: 本日\PNへの賞品は、サスペンションバッジ!

key: \PN received the Suspension Badge!
en: \PN received the Suspension Badge!
ja: \PNはサスペンションバッジを手に入れた!

key: RINGMASTER: The Suspension Badge bestows obedience of Pokémon up to level 80 for its Trainer, AND the ability to use the Machine Fly!
en: RINGMASTER: The Suspension Badge bestows obedience of Pokémon up to level 80 for its Trainer, AND the ability to use the Machine Fly!
ja: 団長: サスペンションバッジがあれば、レベル80までのポケモンが言うことを聞くようになり、さらに『そらをとぶ』のマシンも使えるようになるぞ!

key: But wait, there's more!
en: But wait, there's more!
ja: だが、まだあるぞ!

key: \PN has also won the TM for Acrobatics!
en: \PN has also won the TM for Acrobatics!
ja: \PNはわざマシン『アクロバット』もゲットだ!

key: A flashy move for a flashy show-- perfect, don't you think?
en: A flashy move for a flashy show-- perfect, don't you think?
ja: 派手なショーには派手なわざ――ぴったりだと思わないか?

key: RINGMASTER: And for those of you anxious for their moment with Ciel...
en: RINGMASTER: And for those of you anxious for their moment with Ciel...
ja: 団長: シエルとの一戦を待ちわびてるそこのあなた……

key: Find those Battle Passes!
en: Find those Battle Passes!
ja: バトルパスを見つけるんだ!

key: Thanks for coming, everyone!
en: Thanks for coming, everyone!
ja: みんな、来てくれてありがとう!

key: DONPHAN: Phaaan.
en: DONPHAN: Phaaan.
ja: ドンファン: ドファーン。

key: RINGMASTER: A-ha!
en: RINGMASTER: A-ha!
ja: 団長: おっと!

key: RINGMASTER: I knew it!
en: RINGMASTER: I knew it!
ja: 団長: やっぱりな!

key: I could feel it--
en: I could feel it--
ja: 感じてたんだ――

key: In fact, I could practically smell it--
en: In fact, I could practically smell it--
ja: というか、匂いでわかるくらいだったぜ――

key: One of those Battle Passes making its way back here!
en: One of those Battle Passes making its way back here!
ja: バトルパスの一枚がここに戻ってきてるってな!

key: I'm glad you were able to find one, \PN!
en: I'm glad you were able to find one, \PN!
ja: 見つけてきてくれてうれしいぞ、\PN!

key: And I know that can only mean one thing!
en: And I know that can only mean one thing!
ja: ってことは、意味することはひとつしかない!

key: But first--
en: But first--
ja: だがその前に――

key: Allow me to test your mettle!
en: Allow me to test your mettle!
ja: お前の腕前を試させてもらうぜ!

key: It's all for the show, you see?
en: It's all for the show, you see?
ja: 全部ショーのためなんだよ、わかるか?

key: I gotta know what my crew is up against so I know how to hype it!
en: I gotta know what my crew is up against so I know how to hype it!
ja: うちの連中が何と戦うのか知っておかないと、盛り上げ方も決まらないからな!

key: Even a weak challenger can still be good for an underdog story or just for the trio's rep', but we have to frame it that way!
en: Even a weak challenger can still be good for an underdog story or just for the trio's rep', but we have to frame it that way!
ja: 弱い挑戦者でも判官びいきのネタになるし、三強の名を上げる材料にもなる。でも、そう見せ方を考えないとな!

key: On the other hand, if this is gonna be a nail-biter, I wanna know ahead of time.
en: On the other hand, if this is gonna be a nail-biter, I wanna know ahead of time.
ja: 逆に、手に汗握る接戦になりそうなら、前もって知っておきたい。

key: So, \PN, show me what kind of story we can expect from you!
en: So, \PN, show me what kind of story we can expect from you!
ja: というわけで、\PN、お前がどんな物語を見せてくれるのか、見せてもらうぜ!

key: A nail-biter it is, then!
en: A nail-biter it is, then!
ja: アリスタシア: それなら、手に汗握る接戦にしてみせるよ!

key: RINGMASTER: Maybe even a sweep with some luck...
en: RINGMASTER: Maybe even a sweep with some luck...
ja: 団長: 運が良けりゃ、全勝もあるかもな……

key: Oooh, I do just kind of love it when Samson in particular loses.
en: Oooh, I do just kind of love it when Samson in particular loses.
ja: いやあ、特にサムソンが負けるのを見るのは、なんだかんだ好きなんだよな。

key: No real reason!
en: No real reason!
ja: 特に理由はないぞ!

key: And definitely no under the table bets with him and Ciel about how many times they lose on the challenger's first attempt!
en: And definitely no under the table bets with him and Ciel about how many times they lose on the challenger's first attempt!
ja: サムソンやシエルと、挑戦者の初戦で何回負けるかなんて裏で賭けてることも、絶対にないからな!

key: Nosiree, none of that here!
en: Nosiree, none of that here!
ja: いやいや、そんなことしてないぞ!

key: Anyway, I'll go make preparations at once-- tell Samson to get his butt into gear!
en: Anyway, I'll go make preparations at once-- tell Samson to get his butt into gear!
ja: とにかく、すぐに準備をしてくるよ――サムソンにも尻をたたいておいてくれ!
